control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch
atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work
integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at PSV-7103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on PSV-7103 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically inspecting Ex equipment and enclosures. PSV-7103 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 7 November 2015 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during commissioning of replacement equipment; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
